$comment: Shared by the website (assets/site.js), the export script (.github/scripts/export_discussions.py), and the discussion templates. Theme labels must match the 'Research themes' options in every template exactly; the export script checks this.

themes.label: Mobility & Transportation
themes.blurb: Movement, access, logistics, and the networks that carry them.

themes.label: Built Environment & Land Use
themes.blurb: Buildings, streets, land use, and how cities are designed and developed.

themes.label: Housing & Urban Economics
themes.blurb: Housing markets, affordability, displacement, and the urban economy.

themes.label: Climate, Energy & Resilience
themes.blurb: Heat, flooding, energy, and how cities prepare for and recover from shocks.

themes.label: Health, Equity & Accessibility
themes.blurb: Exposure, access to services, and who benefits from urban change.

themes.label: Urban Sensing & Spatial Data
themes.blurb: Imagery, sensors, mobility traces, and the spatial data infrastructure behind them.

themes.label: Governance & Participation
themes.blurb: Public decisions, participation, and the institutions that shape cities.

themes.label: Urban AI & Simulation
themes.blurb: Models, agents, digital twins, and simulations of urban systems.

categories.label: Introductions
categories.summary: Say who you are, what you work on, and who you would like to meet.

categories.label: Find collaborators
categories.summary: Turn a research question into a team with the right methods and local knowledge.

categories.label: Project showcase
categories.summary: Make a project visible at any stage, and say how others can contribute.

categories.label: Datasets & data requests
categories.summary: Share a documented dataset, or describe the data you need.

categories.label: Tools, code & methods
categories.summary: Share software, code, or a method with what it needs to be reused.

categories.label: Opportunities
categories.summary: List a verified call, grant, position, or challenge with its deadline.

categories.summary: Announce a talk, reading group, clinic, or meetup with its date.

categories.label: Questions
categories.summary: Ask about data, methods, or tools, and mark the answer that solves it.
